hooks.command: f=docs/ENGINEERING_LOG.md; if [ -f "$f" ]; then m=$(stat -f %m "$f" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$f" 2>/dev/null); d=$(( ($(date +%s) - m) / 86400 )); [ "$d" -gt 7 ] && printf '%s' "{\"systemMessage\":\"docs/ENGINEERING_LOG.md has not been updated in $d days - review its Open Backlog section.\"}"; fi; true

git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(src/lib/db/|\.github/workflows/|vps/|supabase/migrations/)' && printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"Infrastructure files changed this session - append what changed, why, and any new gotcha to docs/ENGINEERING_LOG.md before finishing."}' || true
